args.title: Fix password reset email to use correct URL instead of localhost
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email currently generates links pointing to http://localhost:3000 due to the default BASE_URL fallback. This makes the reset link unusable for users outside the local development environment. Change the email template to use a proper production base URL from configuration or environment to avoid sending localhost links in production emails.
